entries.name: Ranked Garrison
entries.notes: Compound name: adjective 'Ranked' from themeAdjectivePools['rusted-legion'], Base noun 'Garrison' invented (a standing posting, not from a pool). Capability atom.econ-muster (resource.economy, OnSpawn, points) reads as the roll call paying out the moment the unit falls in. No elemental param anywhere in this entry, per the theme's avoid-elemental-magic rule. Claims armament-primary only, no armament-secondary in this entry. All four member roles (armament-primary, head-guard, core-guard, footing) are in the hybrid role core. Higher tiers (might, ferocity, vitality) are Flat/Increased stat.modify only - neither More-op family (bulwark, savagery) nor any defense-channel family (warding, resilience) appears, so SetTierForbiddenAtom does not apply.

entries.name: Battered Outpost
entries.notes: Compound name: adjective 'Battered' from themeAdjectivePools['rusted-legion'], Base noun 'Outpost' invented (a forward post nobody has resupplied lately). Capability atom.sust-callus (shield.grant, OnDamageTaken) reads as the last line of scavenged plating hardening exactly when it is hit, not before. No element param used. Claims armament-secondary only, never armament-primary in this entry. All four member roles (armament-secondary, mantle, girdle, jewel-major) are in the hybrid role core. Higher tiers (vitality, fortitude, mending) are Flat/Increased stat.modify only, no More-op or defense-channel family.

entries.name: Sentry of the Barracks
entries.notes: Of-construct name: Base 'Sentry' invented (posted watch, not from a pool) plus Concept 'barracks' from conceptPools['rusted-legion']. Capability atom.entangling (status.apply, a snare status) reads as tripwire and netting strung around the post by whoever last stood this watch - no element param involved. Claims no armament role. jewel-minor-a is included, jewel-minor-b is not, since jewel-minor-b sits outside the hybrid role core (ssot-sets.md 3.7's SetRoleNotUniversal split). All four member roles (core-guard, manipulator, sense, jewel-minor-a) are in the hybrid role core. Higher tiers (fortitude, might, life-graft) are Flat/Increased stat.modify only.

entries.name: Detail of the Depot
entries.notes: Of-construct name: Base 'Detail' invented (a working party pulled off the roster) plus Concept 'depot' from conceptPools['rusted-legion']. Capability atom.volley (spawn.entity, bullet, OnDamageDealt) reads as a coordinated firing drill loosed on command - kind is 'bullet', no element param. Claims armament-primary only, no armament-secondary in this entry. All four member roles (armament-primary, mantle, footing, infusion) are in the hybrid role core. Higher tiers (ferocity, vitality, might) are Flat/Increased stat.modify only, no More-op or defense-channel family.

entries.name: Standing of the Cohort
entries.notes: Of-construct name: Base 'Standing' invented (a unit's rank and record) plus Concept 'cohort' from conceptPools['rusted-legion']. Capability atom.gravemaking (grid.spawn, Grave, OnDeath) reads as the detail that never stops digging, whatever else the cohort is doing - a grid item, no element param. Claims no armament role. All four member roles (head-guard, girdle, retinue, jewel-major) are in the hybrid role core. Higher tiers (mending, fortitude, life-graft) are Flat/Increased stat.modify only, no More-op or defense-channel family.

entries.name: Trained Flagpost
entries.notes: Compound name: adjective 'Trained' from themeAdjectivePools['rusted-legion'], Base noun 'Flagpost' - the whole-token atomic seed from uniqueSetSeedPools['rusted-legion'], used as the compound's Base exactly as the exemplar's own 'Riveted Ironstem' pairs an adjective with a seed-pool Base; never decomposed into 'flag' + 'post'. This partition's one grand (6-piece) set, per ssot-sets.md 3.4's 'exception, not the pattern' - it carries the mandatory thresholds at 2 and 4 plus a top threshold at 6, equal to its member count, so SetThresholdUnreachable does not apply. Capability atom.retribution (resource.delta, OnDamageTaken) is powerBand medium rather than low, matching the grand-set convention already used on this fleet's thorned-chassis sibling's own 6-piece entry - the six-slot commitment earns a stronger splash than a typical 4-piece set. Claims armament-secondary only, never armament-primary in this entry. Six distinct member roles (armament-secondary, core-guard, head-guard, mantle, sense, footing), all in the hybrid role core, none repeated within this entry. Tagged 'signature' (notability axis, tags.v1.json) as the partition's flagship - a curation flag, not a power claim. Higher tiers (vitality, fortitude, might, ferocity) are Flat/Increased stat.modify only, no More-op family.
